_comment: full_config_reference.json — Complete reference for all supported conversion types.
_note: This file is documentation only. Copy the relevant 'conversions' entries into your real config.
name: full_reference

plot_config._doc: Optional auto-plot section. If enabled, each imported file will generate the configured figures.

conversions._doc2: TYPE: expr  (DEFAULT — math expression via pandas eval)
conversions.name: voltage

conversions._doc4: Method 'ieee754': raw hex bytes reinterpreted as IEEE-754 float.
conversions.name: ieee_float32

conversions._doc: Method 'divide': convert hex → int, then divide by divisor.
conversions.name: sensor_mv

conversions._doc2: TYPE: hex_to_fixedpoint  — hex string → fixed-point float
conversions._doc5: Unsigned Q8.8 (16-bit, 8 integer bits, 8 fractional bits).
conversions.name: gain_q8_8

conversions._doc2: TYPE: bitmask  — extract bit field from an integer column
conversions._doc5: Source may be an integer column OR a hex-string column (auto-converted).
conversions.name: status_lower_nibble

conversions._doc2: TYPE: lookup  — map discrete values to labels or numbers
conversions._doc4: Keys in 'map' are matched as strings (source values are cast to str).
conversions.name: mode_label

conversions._doc: Numeric lookup (map to floats for downstream math).
conversions.name: gain_factor

conversions._doc2: TYPE: scale  — linear scaling: result = source * factor + offset
conversions.name: temperature_c

conversions._doc3: Conversions run sequentially. A later step may reference
conversions._doc4: a column produced by an earlier step.
conversions.name: raw_int

conversions._chain_step2_comment: Step 2: extract bit field from the int column produced in step 1
conversions.name: channel_id

conversions._chain_step3_comment: Step 3: scale the extracted channel value
conversions.name: channel_voltage

_postprocess_doc3: Applies AFTER conversions (and after downsampling if timing='after_conversions').
_postprocess_doc4: Use this to clean up plot selectors without changing conversion formulas.

postprocess_columns._doc_hidden: Columns to hide from plot selectors but keep in the imported dataframe.
postprocess_columns._doc_deleted: Columns to remove from dataframe after processing completes.

_downsampling_doc3: Reduces the number of rows in the imported dataset at import time.
_downsampling_doc4: The imported dataframe is replaced with the downsampled result.
_downsampling_doc5: Dataset name in the UI becomes:  <filename>_downsampled_<method>

downsampling._doc_enabled: Set to true to activate downsampling on every import using this config.
downsampling._doc_timing: When to apply downsampling in the import pipeline.
downsampling._doc_timing2: 'before_conversions' (default) — downsample raw data first, then run
downsampling._doc_timing3: conversion formulas on fewer rows (faster for large files).
downsampling._doc_timing4: 'after_conversions'  — run all conversions first, then downsample so
downsampling._doc_timing5: all derived columns are included in the reduced dataset.
downsampling._doc_decimation3: Anti-alias lowpass filter + integer-factor stride reduction.
downsampling._doc_decimation4: Requires UNIFORM sampling on the x-axis.
downsampling._doc_decimation5: Effective sample rate becomes:  original_hz / factor

decimation._doc_factor: Integer decimation factor (>= 2). Keeps every Nth sample.

downsampling._doc_lttb4: Tolerates non-uniform x spacing; only requires monotonic x-axis.
downsampling._doc_lttb5: Best choice for plot-quality reduction without signal analysis.
downsampling._doc_dwt3: Discrete Wavelet Transform approximation — analysis-oriented lossy transform.
downsampling._doc_dwt4: Requires UNIFORM sampling on the x-axis.
downsampling._doc_dwt5: Output length with reconstruct=false: N / 2^level.  With reconstruct=true: N (smoothed).

dwt._doc_wavelet: PyWavelets wavelet name (e.g. 'db4', 'haar', 'sym8'). Call pywt.wavelist() for all options.
dwt._doc_level: Decomposition level (>= 1). Higher = more aggressive reduction.
dwt._doc_reconstruct: true: reconstruct signal back to original length (smoothed, same N).
dwt._doc_reconstruct2: false: keep approximation coefficients only (shorter output, N/2^level).
